installer_failure_injection.verify_stage_contract: The Apply action succeeds and a separate Verify action fails, exercising the verify rollback path

execution_scope: External tool execution authorized in isolated project tool directories; installer/service/VHD operations only on isolated CI, never on the local host or existing physical disks
